programme.name: BSc in Optometry

admission.title: Eligibility & Admission Criteria (DSE)
content: **Admission Score Formula**: Any Best 5 Subjects (plus 6th subject bonus).
**Average HKDSE Score with Subject Weighting**: 285.6 (2025 JUPAS data).
**Median Admission Score**: 278.0 (2025 JUPAS data).
**Lower Quartile**: 279.5 (2025 JUPAS data).
**Subject Weighting**: Subject weighting in details.
**Core Subjects Minimum Level**: Chinese Language 3, English Language 3, Mathematics (Compulsory Part) 2, Citizenship and Social Development Attained.
**Elective Subjects**: ANY 2 SUBJECTS at Level 3.
**Interview**: Yes. Selective basis
**Duration**: 4 years full-time.
**First Year Tuition**: HK$44,500 (local students).
**Note**: Subject weightings apply. See "Weightings" for details.

curriculum.title: Curriculum Structure
content: **Programme Overview**: JS3290 BSc in Optometry is a 5-year full-time honours programme offered by PolyU's Faculty of Health. It integrates clinical training with theoretical knowledge, preparing students for professional registration as optometrists in Hong Kong.
**Year 1**: Foundation sciences including human biology, optics, and introductory optometry. Students also take general university requirements and begin developing clinical observation skills.

**Year 2**: Core optometry subjects such as ocular anatomy, visual optics, and binocular vision. Practical laboratory sessions complement lectures, and students start supervised patient contact in PolyU's Optometry Clinic.

**Year 3**: Advanced clinical modules including contact lenses, low vision, and paediatric optometry. Students undertake clinical placements in the university's on-campus clinic and external partner facilities.

**Year 4**: Specialised training in ocular disease diagnosis, pharmacology, and advanced contact lens fitting. Work-Integrated Education (WIE) placements in hospitals and private practices provide real-world experience.

**Year 5**: Final year includes a capstone research project, advanced clinical practice, and preparation for the Optometrists Board licensing examination. Graduates are eligible to apply for registration with the Optometrists Board of Hong Kong.

career.title: Career Prospects
content: **Professional Registration**: Graduates are eligible to sit for the Optometrists Board of Hong Kong licensing examination, leading to full registration as a practising optometrist.
**Clinical Roles**: Common career paths include optometrist in private practice, hospital eye departments, or optical retail chains such as Optical 88 and LensCrafters.
**Public Health Sector**: Opportunities in the Hospital Authority, Department of Health, or community health centres focusing on vision screening and public eye health programmes.
**Research and Academia**: Graduates can pursue postgraduate studies (MPhil/PhD) in vision science or clinical optometry at PolyU or overseas universities, leading to research or teaching careers.

**Industry and Entrepreneurship**: Roles in optical product development, corporate management of optical chains, or starting independent optometry clinics. The Greater Bay Area offers expanding opportunities.
**Average Starting Salary**: Fresh graduates typically earn HKD 30,000–40,000 per month, with experienced optometrists earning significantly more in private practice.

campus.title: Campus Life and Facilities
content: **Prime Location**: PolyU is located in Hung Hom, Kowloon, directly connected to Hung Hom MTR station (East Rail Line and Tuen Ma Line), providing easy access from all parts of Hong Kong.
**Optometry Clinic**: The on-campus PolyU Optometry Clinic is a state-of-the-art teaching and research facility, offering comprehensive eye care services to the public while training students.
**Clinical Skills Labs**: Dedicated laboratories equipped with slit lamps, autorefractors, and retinal imaging systems allow hands-on practice in a simulated clinical environment.
**Library and Learning Resources**: The Pao Yue-kong Library provides extensive collections in health sciences, including online journals, textbooks, and study spaces open 24/7 during exam periods.
**Student Societies**: The PolyU Optometry Society organises academic workshops, social events, and community vision screening activities, fostering a strong peer network.
**Sports and Recreation**: The campus features a sports centre with a gymnasium, swimming pool, and multi-purpose courts, plus nearby waterfront promenades for relaxation.

competitiveness.title: Competitiveness & Admission Requirements
content: **Overall Level**: High (★★★★☆)
**Median Score (2025)**: The median HKDSE score with subject weighting was 278.0, indicating strong competition for places.
**Lower Quartile (2025)**: The lower quartile was 279.5, meaning even the bottom 25% of admitted students achieved very high scores.
**Average Score**: The average HKDSE score with subject weighting was 285.6, reflecting the programme's high academic standards.

**Admission Formula**: Scores are calculated using Any Best 5 Subjects, with a bonus for a 6th subject. Core subjects (English, Chinese, Mathematics, Liberal Studies/Citizenship) are weighted more heavily.
**Subject Weighting**: English Language and Mathematics are weighted at 1.5x, while Science subjects (Biology, Chemistry, Physics) receive 1.2x weighting. Other subjects are weighted at 1.0x.

alumni.title: Notable Alumni
content: **Dr. Vincent Lee (李振英)**: President of the Hong Kong Society of Professional Optometrists. Graduated from PolyU's Optometry programme in 1995. Advocate for optometry regulation and public eye health.
**Dr. Carly Lam (林彩霞)**: Former Head of PolyU's School of Optometry, now Professor Emeritus. Pioneered research in myopia control and contact lens safety. Graduated in 1988.
**Dr. Maureen Boost (布思)**: Renowned researcher in ocular microbiology and infection control at PolyU. Published over 100 peer-reviewed papers. Graduated with a PhD in 1995.
**Dr. Andrew Siu (蕭志強)**: Clinical optometrist and lecturer at PolyU, specialising in low vision and paediatric optometry. Graduated in 2002. Active in community vision screening programmes.
**Dr. Peggy Cheung (張佩琪)**: Founder of Vision First Eye Care Centre, a leading private optometry practice in Central. Graduated in 2008. Known for advanced contact lens fitting.
**Dr. Thomas Chan (陳偉明)**: Chief Optometrist at the Hospital Authority's Kowloon Central Cluster. Graduated in 1999. Oversees eye care services across multiple public hospitals.

scholarships.title: Scholarships and Financial Aid
content: **PolyU Entry Scholarship**: Awarded to top HKDSE applicants with scores above 300 (weighted). Covers full tuition fees and provides a living allowance of up to HKD 50,000 per year.
**Faculty of Health Scholarships**: Multiple merit-based scholarships for optometry students, ranging from HKD 10,000 to HKD 40,000 per year, based on academic performance.
**Dr. the Honourable Sir Run Run Shaw Scholarship**: Prestigious award for outstanding students in health sciences, including optometry. Provides HKD 60,000 annually.
**Hong Kong Optometric Association Scholarship**: Sponsored by the professional body, offering HKD 20,000 to students demonstrating clinical excellence and community service.
**Government Financial Assistance**: Eligible students can apply for the HKSAR Government's Student Financial Assistance Agency (SFAA) schemes, including grants and low-interest loans.
**Work-Integrated Education Stipend**: Students on clinical placements may receive a stipend of up to HKD 10,000 per semester from partner hospitals and clinics.

tips.title: Ace Sir's JS3290 Strategy — 9 Actionable Tips
content: **1. Prioritise Core Subjects**: Focus on English and Mathematics — both are weighted at 1.5x. Aim for Level 5 or above in these subjects to maximise your weighted score.
- Dedicate extra time to English reading comprehension and writing, as these are critical for the optometry curriculum.
- For Mathematics, practice past papers and focus on statistics and algebra, which are relevant to visual optics calculations.
**2. Leverage Science Subjects**: Biology, Chemistry, and Physics receive 1.2x weighting. Take at least two of these to boost your score. Biology is especially relevant for ocular anatomy.
- Study cellular biology and human physiology in depth, as these form the foundation of optometry.
- Chemistry knowledge of drug interactions is useful for pharmacology modules in Year 4.
**3. Target a Weighted Score Above 285**: The average admitted score is 285.6. Use the PolyU admission calculator to simulate your best 5 subjects plus a 6th subject bonus.
- If your best 5 subjects total 270, adding a 6th subject at Level 4 can push you above the average.
- Aim for at least Level 5 in three subjects to build a strong buffer.
**4. Excel in Liberal Studies/Citizenship**: While weighted at 1.0x, this subject is often overlooked. A Level 5 here can differentiate you from other applicants.
- Focus on public health and science-related issues in the exam, as these align with optometry themes.
- Practice data-response questions to improve analytical skills.
**5. Build a Strong ECA Profile**: Optometry values communication and empathy. Volunteer at elderly centres or vision screening events to demonstrate commitment to eye care.
- Join the PolyU Optometry Society's pre-admission events to network with current students.
- Highlight any shadowing experience with optometrists in your personal statement.
**6. Prepare for the Interview**: Shortlisted candidates may be invited for an interview. Expect questions on motivation, ethical scenarios, and current eye health issues in Hong Kong.
- Research the Optometrists Board's code of ethics and recent news on myopia prevalence.
- Practice explaining why you chose optometry over other healthcare professions.
**7. Use the 6th Subject Bonus Wisely**: If you take 6 subjects, even a Level 4 in the 6th subject adds points. Choose a subject where you can score well, such as Economics or Geography.
- Avoid overloading — quality matters more than quantity. Ensure your best 5 subjects are strong first.
- Check the bonus formula: the 6th subject score is added at 50% of its value.
**8. Understand the Clinical Commitment**: Optometry is a 5-year programme with significant clinical hours. Be prepared for hands-on learning and patient interaction from Year 2 onwards.
- Visit the PolyU Optometry Clinic for a tour during open days to see the facilities.
- Talk to current students about the workload and time management strategies.
**9. Plan for Licensing Exam**: The Optometrists Board exam is taken after graduation. Start preparing early by reviewing past exam papers and joining study groups.
- PolyU's curriculum is designed to cover all exam topics, but self-study is essential.
- Consider joining the Hong Kong Society of Professional Optometrists as a student member for resources.

admission.title: 入學要求與計分詳情 (DSE)
content: **入學計分公式**：任何最佳五科 (另加第6科加分)。
**文憑試成績平均積點（計算科目比重後）**：285.6（2025年聯招數據）。
**科目比重**：Subject weighting in details。
**核心科目最低要求**：中國語文第3級、英國語文第3級、數學（必修部分）第2級、公民與社會發展科達標。
**選修科目**：任何2科達第3級。
**面試**：需要。Selective basis
**修讀年期**：4年全日制。
**首年學費**：港幣44,500元（本地學生）。
**備註**：科目比重詳見「比重」按鈕。

curriculum.title: 課程結構
content: **課程概覽**：JS3290 眼科視光學(榮譽)理學士是一個五年全日制榮譽學位課程，由理大健康學院開辦。課程結合臨床培訓與理論知識，為學生在香港註冊成為眼科視光師做好準備。
**第一年**：基礎科學包括人體生物學、光學及眼科視光學導論。學生亦修讀大學核心課程，並開始培養臨床觀察技巧。
**第二年**：核心眼科視光學科目包括眼部解剖學、視覺光學及雙眼視覺。實驗室實習輔助課堂教學，學生開始在理大眼科視光學診所進行有監督的病人接觸。
**第三年**：高級臨床模組包括隱形眼鏡、低視力及兒科眼科視光學。學生在校內診所及外部合作機構進行臨床實習。
**第四年**：專科培訓包括眼疾診斷、藥理學及高級隱形眼鏡驗配。工作綜合教育（WIE）實習在醫院及私營診所進行，提供真實工作經驗。
**第五年**：最後一年包括頂石研究項目、高級臨床實踐及準備眼科視光師管理局執業考試。畢業生可申請在香港眼科視光師管理局註冊。

career.title: 就業前景
content: **專業註冊**：畢業生可參加香港眼科視光師管理局執業考試，取得全面註冊成為執業眼科視光師。
**臨床職位**：常見職業路徑包括在私營診所、醫院眼科部門或眼鏡連鎖店（如眼鏡88及LensCrafters）擔任眼科視光師。
**公共衛生領域**：在醫院管理局、衛生署或社區健康中心從事視力篩查及公眾眼睛健康計劃的工作機會。
**研究與學術**：畢業生可在理大或海外大學攻讀視覺科學或臨床眼科視光學的研究生課程（哲學碩士/博士），從事研究或教學工作。
**行業與創業**：在光學產品開發、眼鏡連鎖企業管理或開設獨立眼科視光診所的角色。大灣區提供更多擴展機會。
**平均起薪**：應屆畢業生月薪通常為港幣30,000至40,000元，經驗豐富的視光師在私營診所收入更高。

campus.title: 校園生活與設施
content: **優越地理位置**：理大位於九龍紅磡，直接連接紅磡港鐵站（東鐵線及屯馬線），從香港各區均可輕鬆到達。
**眼科視光學診所**：校內的理大眼科視光學診所是一個先進的教學及研究設施，為公眾提供全面眼睛護理服務，同時培訓學生。
**臨床技能實驗室**：配備裂隙燈、自動驗光儀及視網膜成像系統的專用實驗室，讓學生在模擬臨床環境中進行實踐操作。
**圖書館與學習資源**：包玉剛圖書館提供豐富的健康科學藏書，包括網上期刊、教科書及考試期間24小時開放的學習空間。
**學生學會**：理大眼科視光學學會舉辦學術工作坊、社交活動及社區視力篩查活動，促進強大的同儕網絡。
**體育與康樂**：校園設有體育中心，包括健身室、游泳池及多用途球場，附近還有海濱長廊供放鬆身心。

competitiveness.title: 競爭力與入學要求
content: **2025年中位數分數**：經科目加權後的HKDSE中位數分數為278.0，顯示學位競爭激烈。
**2025年下四分位數**：下四分位數為279.5，意味著即使最低的25%錄取學生也取得非常高的分數。
**平均分數**：經科目加權後的HKDSE平均分數為285.6，反映課程的高學術標準。
**入學計算公式**：分數以最佳五科計算，並設有第六科加分。核心科目（英文、中文、數學、通識/公民科）權重較高。
**科目權重**：英文及數學權重為1.5倍，科學科目（生物、化學、物理）權重為1.2倍。其他科目權重為1.0倍。

alumni.title: 知名校友
content: **李振英博士**：香港執業眼科視光師協會會長。1995年畢業於理大眼科視光學課程。倡導視光師規管及公眾眼睛健康。
**林彩霞博士**：前理大眼科視光學院主任，現為榮休教授。近視控制及隱形眼鏡安全研究的先驅。1988年畢業。
**布思博士**：理大眼部微生物學及感染控制的知名研究員。發表超過100篇同行評審論文。1995年獲得博士學位。
**蕭志強博士**：理大臨床眼科視光師及講師，專注低視力及兒科眼科視光學。2002年畢業。積極參與社區視力篩查計劃。
**張佩琪博士**：Vision First Eye Care Centre創辦人，中環領先的私營眼科視光診所。2008年畢業。以高級隱形眼鏡驗配聞名。
**陳偉明博士**：醫院管理局九龍中聯網首席眼科視光師。1999年畢業。監督多間公立醫院的眼睛護理服務。

scholarships.title: 獎學金與經濟援助
content: **理大入學獎學金**：頒予加權分數超過300分的頂尖HKDSE申請者。涵蓋全額學費並提供每年高達港幣50,000元的生活津貼。
**健康學院獎學金**：多項基於成績的獎學金，適用於眼科視光學學生，每年金額由港幣10,000元至40,000元不等，根據學業表現頒發。
**邵逸夫博士獎學金**：頒予健康科學（包括眼科視光學）優秀學生的著名獎項。每年提供港幣60,000元。
**香港眼科視光師協會獎學金**：由專業機構贊助，提供港幣20,000元予在臨床表現及社區服務方面出色的學生。
**政府經濟援助**：合資格學生可申請香港特區政府學生資助處（SFAA）的計劃，包括助學金及低息貸款。
**工作綜合教育津貼**：參與臨床實習的學生可從合作醫院及診所獲得每學期高達港幣10,000元的津貼。

tips.title: Ace Sir JS3290 攻略 — 9 個實用貼士
content: **1. 優先處理核心科目**：專注英文及數學——兩者權重均為1.5倍。目標在這些科目取得5級或以上，以最大化加權分數。
- 在英文閱讀理解及寫作上投入額外時間，因為這些對眼科視光學課程至關重要。
- 數學方面，練習歷屆試題並專注統計學及代數，這些與視覺光學計算相關。
**2. 善用科學科目**：生物、化學及物理獲1.2倍權重。至少選修其中兩科以提升分數。生物學尤其與眼部解剖學相關。
- 深入學習細胞生物學及人體生理學，因為這些是眼科視光學的基礎。
- 化學的藥物相互作用知識對四年級藥理學模組有用。
**3. 目標加權分數超過285分**：平均錄取分數為285.6。使用理大入學計算器模擬你的最佳五科加上第六科加分。
- 如果你的最佳五科總分為270，加上第六科4級可將分數推至平均以上。
- 目標在三科取得至少5級，以建立穩固的緩衝。
**4. 在通識/公民科表現出色**：雖然權重為1.0倍，但這科常被忽略。在此科取得5級可讓你與其他申請者區分開來。
- 在考試中專注公共衛生及科學相關議題，這些與眼科視光學主題一致。
- 練習數據回應題以提升分析能力。
**5. 建立強大的課外活動檔案**：眼科視光學重視溝通及同理心。在長者中心或視力篩查活動中擔任義工，展示你對眼睛護理的承諾。
- 參加理大眼科視光學學會的預先入學活動，與現屆學生建立聯繫。
- 在個人陳述中強調任何跟隨眼科視光師的見習經驗。
**6. 為面試做好準備**：入圍候選人可能獲邀參加面試。預期問題包括動機、道德情境及香港當前眼睛健康議題。
- 研究眼科視光師管理局的專業守則及近期關於近視普及的新聞。
- 練習解釋為何選擇眼科視光學而非其他醫療專業。
**7. 明智使用第六科加分**：如果你修讀六科，即使第六科取得4級也能加分。選擇你能取得好成績的科目，如經濟或地理。
- 避免過度負荷——質量比數量更重要。確保你的最佳五科首先表現強勁。
- 檢查加分公式：第六科分數以50%價值加入。
**8. 了解臨床承諾**：眼科視光學是一個五年制課程，包含大量臨床時數。從第二年開始，準備好進行實踐學習及與病人互動。
- 在開放日參觀理大眼科視光學診所，了解設施。
- 與現屆學生討論工作量及時間管理策略。
**9. 為執業考試做好規劃**：眼科視光師管理局考試在畢業後進行。提早開始準備，複習歷屆試題並加入學習小組。
- 理大的課程設計涵蓋所有考試主題，但自學至關重要。
- 考慮以學生會員身份加入香港執業眼科視光師協會，獲取資源。
